form_analysis.feedback: Excellent aftercare form for psoriasis laser therapy with comprehensive guidance on this chronic condition management. Strong emphasis on the extended treatment series and combination with systemic therapies.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for targeted UVB laser therapy (excimer laser) for psoriasis plaques. Delivers precise UVB to affected areas while sparing healthy skin. Used for localized, stubborn plaques.

instructions.general_directive: Follow throughout treatment series (6-12 weeks) and maintenance period. Psoriasis is chronic; laser provides control not cure.

sections.title: Psoriasis Laser Mechanism
sections.content: Excimer laser delivers 308nm UVB light to psoriatic plaques. Suppresses T-cell activity and slows keratinocyte proliferation. Requires multiple treatments for clearance.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Response
items: Plaques may initially look slightly worse.

sections.title: Treatment Series Importance
items: Initial series: 2-3 treatments per week for 6-12 weeks.
Maintenance: Weekly or bi-weekly after clearance.
Response varies by: Plaque thickness, body location, individual factors.
May require 20-30 treatments for significant clearance.

sections.title: Koebner Phenomenon Prevention
sections.content: Psoriasis can develop at sites of skin injury (Koebner). After laser: 1) Avoid scratching/irritating treated areas 2) Use gentle skincare 3) Report any new plaques at treatment sites.

sections.title: Combination with Systemic Therapies
sections.content: Laser often combined with: 1) Topical steroids between sessions 2) Vitamin D analogs 3) Systemic medications for widespread disease. Coordinate with dermatologist for comprehensive management.

sections.title: Maintenance Protocol
items: After clearance: Gradually extend time between treatments.
Continue good skincare: Moisturize daily, avoid triggers.
Monitor for flare-ups, especially with stress/illness.

sections.title: Realistic Psoriasis Expectations
items: Best for localized disease (<10% body surface).
